kitDescription: Snow White: Heavy Arms is a Water SR Attacker (Burst III) who charges her weapon; while charging she designates Lock-On targets (max 5) and loads Auto Fire ammo, then on Full Charge fires an AoE hit to all enemies plus a sequence of stronger shots against Lock-On targets that scales with the ammo she loaded. Her Burst enters 'Seven Dwarves Fully Active' — for two uses it lengthens her charge to 3.2s and massively raises Lock-On/ammo caps plus charge- and sequential-damage, producing a large burst-window volley. She layers self ATK buffs on Full Charge (46.84%), on entering Burst Stage 3 (73.92%), and during Burst (84.48% + attack-damage), and stacks a Damage-Taken debuff on Lock-On enemies (4.2%/4s). Against a partless Fire boss she carries Water elemental advantage, while her Damage-to-Parts (62.64%) and Pierce buffs are inert there.

verdictRationale: Every kit line is FAITHFUL or a DOCUMENTED_GAP — faithfulness 1.0, no REAL-GOTCHAs. The two blind re-derivations converge on the load-bearing structure: S6 independently derived the 41.9 + 527.95 (105.59x5) sequential lump and the 4.2% boss debuff, and S5's intent-remapped assertions (atkPct 73.92/46.84, attackDamagePct 84.48, chargeDamagePct 528 Fully-Active-gated, sequential 158.4) all green against the shipped override. The S5 literal RED diffs (§6 i-iii — ov.blocks[] vs skill1/skill2/burst accessor, 2-arg harness, totalDamage field) are RECON_ERROR from schema-blindness, not divergences. The one substantive stat-key divergence (blind's sequentialMultPct vs driver's sequentialDamagePct, §6 iv) resolves in the driver's favor: sequentialDamagePct is the engine-real additive key, and both are inert-on-riders per fact (c). The driver is notably MORE complete than the S6 blind, which did not model the weaponSwap/1055.9 fifteen-ammo Fully Active volley or the 3.2s charge mode. Discrimination is real (each FAITHFUL line green-vs-shipped and red-vs-nearest-wrong, 30/30 S2d PASS). Three documented residuals for owner spot-check, none faithfulness failures: (a) stageEnter:3 vs burstCast is frame-indiscriminable in a sole-B3 fixture; (b) whileSwapped/durationSec:10 vs durationShots per-swap is a damage-equivalent duration representation; (c) sequentialDamagePct 158.4 is inert on flatDamage riders — an engine-core plumbing question, out of gauntlet scope. Same-model residual: S5/S6 are both claude-opus-4-8 (S2b is fable-5), so convergence proves stability more than independent correctness — the owner should spot-check the sequentialDamagePct routing (fact c) and the stageEnter-vs-burstCast trigger in a non-sole-B3 comp.
